title: Explicit Twisted Hilbert Class Components Beyond Classical Irregularity
summary: Let $p \equiv 1 \pmod 6$ be prime and $K_p = \mathbf{Q}(ζ_{3p})$. We study the reflected circular unit $μ_p = (1+zζ_p)/(1+\bar zζ_p)$, $z = -ζ_3^2$, and its character projections. A universal Stirling polynomial $P_m$ gives an exact identity between the anti-spectrum of $μ_p$ and the primitive divided $χ_{-3}$-twisted Stickelberger spectrum: $P_{p-j}(h) - P_{p-j}(1-h) = -(2h-1)(j-1)!\,b_j$, $h = z/(1+z)$. Thus the locally blind lines of the reflected unit are precisely the zeros of the corresponding divided twisted Bernoulli eigenvalues. For every $p < 500$ we enumerate these zeros. Exactly…
